title: 5 Tricolour Themed Recipes To Try This Independence Day 2025 | Lifestyle News - News18
text: Happy Independence Day 2025: On Friday, August 15, India will celebrate its 79th Independence Day — a day that brings back the memory of the bravery, sacrifices, and aspirations of the freedom fighters. Since 1947 to the present, this process has converted India from a colonised country to the largest democracy in the world. The Indian flag’s colours will fill streets, schools and houses. The air will ring with patriotic tunes, and the aura of oneness will glow brighter than before. ALSO READ: Happy Independence Day 2025: 15th August Wishes, Inspiring Quotes, Images, SMS, And Status To Share With Friends, Family And Colleagues Food has an equally significant role in this celebration. Communities and families gather to prepare meals based on the saffron, white, and green of the Indian tricolour. Meals become a reflection of patriotism towards the country. Preparing tricolour-themed meals is painting a plate with patriotism. Light, healthy, and lovely, tricolour idlis stack turmeric, carrots, and spinach into a single plate. It’s a light yet satisfying breakfast that evokes the festive atmosphere. Pair it with coconut chutney and sambar for the ideal beginning. ALSO READ: Happy Independence Day 2025: Patriotic Quotes By Freedom Fighters Of India To Share As Wishes And Messages On 15th August Bold flavours and bright colours come together in this Independence Day version of paneer tikka. Marinated in saffron, white, and green spiced yoghurts, the skewers are smoky, tangy, and celebratory. Share with loved ones. This cool dessert stacks mango puree, creamy yoghurt, and strawberry puree into a glass. Garnished with granola and mint, it’s pretty and refreshing. A light dessert for a summer celebration. Steamed to their fluffiest, this Gujarati snack makes a patriotic appearance. Soft, spongy tricolour layers of spinach green, plain white, and carrot orange make for a showstopper. Served best with tangy chutney. ALSO READ: Independence Day 2025: Theme, History, Significance, Guestlist And 79th I-Day Celebrations Loaded with banana, mango, spinach, and coconut milk, this smoothie bowl is as healthy as it is stunning. Every spoonful bursts with fresh flavours. A guilt-free, Instagram-worthy way to finish your meal. Homes and restaurants across the nation are welcoming the tricolour theme. Preparing these recipes in unison can be a moment of bonding, making the kitchen a hub of love and innovation. This August 15, let your dinner table mirror the joy, diversity, and unity that make up India.
